scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @belikh/jupiter-admin
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @belikh/jupiter-admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @belikh/jupiter-tokens && npm run typecheck -w @belikh/jupiter-ui && npm run typecheck -w @belikh/jupiter-admin
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-divergence.mjs && npm run lint:style -w @belikh/jupiter-admin && node scripts/check-skill.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm test -w @belikh/jupiter-ui && npm test -w @belikh/jupiter-admin && npm test -w @belikh/jupiter-esphome && npm test -w @belikh/jupiter-github && npm test -w @belikh/jupiter-docs
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @belikh/jupiter-tokens && npm run build -w @belikh/jupiter-graphics && npm run build -w @belikh/jupiter-esphome && npm run build -w @belikh/jupiter-github
scripts.docs:check: node packages/docs/bin/jupiter-docs.mjs check && node packages/docs/bin/jupiter-docs.mjs build --check
